pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[Female Vocal - airy whisper + soft hum]
(soft pulsing pads, distant water-drop pluck, wide reverb, bittersweet night atmosphere)

Every time you smile… my heart aches…
We knew it would hurt… but we stayed…

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
(behind-the-beat, breathy, locked to kick/snare)

Every time you smile it hurts inside
We both knew we were in pain
But we pretended until the end
Scared that holding your hand
Would make you crumble like me

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(sub bass follows kick, minimal pads)

I wish we could dream together
But I think we’ve reached the end
A love that could never quite reach
Now it’s time to let each other go

[Hook]
[Female Vocal - phonetic loop]
(slight silence before, then full groove impact)

The closer we get… the more it hurts
We loved too much… we knew too much
I can’t let you cry anymore
So I’ll walk away

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(repeat hook with layered airy ad-libs)

The closer we get… the more it hurts
We loved too much… we knew too much
I can’t let you cry anymore
So I’ll let you go

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
(more textured rasp, close mic)

Now I finally understand
The more I tried to hold you, the more I pushed you away
I loved you as much as you loved me
That’s why this is so painful

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(pads pulse stronger)

We were each other’s first and last love
Thank you… and I’m sorry
Every moment you were in my life
Was real love… true love

[Hook 2]
[Female Vocal]
(stronger groove, add light vocal fry)

The closer we get… the more it hurts
We loved too much… we knew too much
I can’t let you cry anymore
So I’ll let you go

[Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(full layers, humming in background)

The closer we get… the more it hurts
We loved too much… we knew too much
I can’t let you cry anymore
So I’ll let you go

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal - half-whisper]
(everything drops to sub bass + soft pads)

Why couldn’t we become one…
Thank you… and goodbye…

[Rap]
[Female Vocal - low, breathy, close]
(exact drum interlock, behind snare)

I was scared you’d break if I held you too tight
So I stayed silent while my heart cried
This is my last love, my only one
You were my beginning and my end
I loved you… I really loved you
Now I’ll say goodbye… so you can fly
Yeah… this is love…

[Break]
[Instrumental + Humming]
(only water-drop pluck + pulsing pads, airy hums)

[Final Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(max layers, rich reverb)

The closer we get… the more it hurts
But every scar was proof we loved
Thank you for being my love
Goodbye… my only one

[Outro]
[Female Vocal - fading]
(heavy reverb, last syllable fry, slow fade)

I loved you… goodbye…
(soft humming till end)
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
